atoms.b: Hi! My name is Kathy and I am an archaeologist. I study the ((++past arachnids)) by exploring ancient sites and excavating, or digging up, artefacts.

hint.text: An artefact is an old object, such as a tool or piece of jewellery, that shows us what life was like for people a long time ago.
hint.label: Artefacts

atoms.b: I specialise in ancient Egyptian history, which makes me ((++an_Egyptologist a_Hebraist)).
Today, I would like to take you to Abu Simbel and the Valley of the Kings: two places containing some of the most famous ((++tombs longhouses)) found in Egypt!

instruction.text: Drag the three archaeological tools into Kathy’s suitcase.

atoms.b: Welcome to Abu Simbel! Two ((++temples towers)) were rediscovered here in 1813 and are known for the ((++statues holograms)) of Ramesses II that guard the entrance. Each one is approximately 20 metres tall!
And this is the Valley of the Kings! It is located next to the city of ((++Luxor Leeds)). It served as a burial site for ((++pharaohs toys)) of the New Kingdom.
The Valley of the Kings contains at least 65 tombs, including that of the famous Pharaoh ((++Tutankhamun Caesar)), which was uncovered by Howard Carter.
